collection_independence: Official personal bibliographies and official publication metadata only. No Resolver, Collector, ownership, PDF or performance run outputs are used as reference answers.

professors.name: Emma Brunskill
professors.selection_reason: Public chronological bibliography; reinforcement learning and educational applications; bounded historical slice suitable for individual review.

professors.name: Aarti Singh
professors.selection_reason: Public publication list; statistical and interactive machine learning; useful explicit same-name bibliography risk for human identity checking.
identity_risks: The public DBLP bibliography reports an ORCID conflict. Neither ORCID nor every record in that bibliography is assumed to belong to this professor.

professors.name: Jacob Steinhardt
professors.selection_reason: Personal bibliography provides machine-readable citations; robustness, language models and alignment; manageable historical publication window.

unknown_type_policy: Remain candidate until reviewed; neither include nor exclude automatically.
version_policy: Each formal publication/version has its own identity. Preprints are related versions, not additional core positives. Conference and journal versions stay separate unless a reviewer explicitly establishes an equivalent bibliographic record. Title equality alone never establishes version equivalence.
doi_policy: Use only identifiers actually supplied by reference sources. Missing DOI remains null. Journal DOIs reported on preprint pages are related identifiers until a reviewer confirms their meaning.
coverage_policy: This is a candidate pool, not a complete professor career bibliography. The human reviewer must audit missing venues, source failures, versions and scope before declaring a positive list complete.
